test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The cost price of an article is ₹ 214. After allowing three successive discounts of 15%, 20% and 10% on its price, it is sold for ₹ 153. If is sold at the list price, then the profit (in ₹) will be:
solution:
**Given:**

CP = Rs. 214

SP = Rs. 153

Three discount % are 15%, 20% and 10%

**Concept used:**

SP = MP - MP × Discount%

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

MP = 153 × 100/85 × 100/80 × 100/90

⇒ MP = 153 × 1000/612

⇒ MP = 250

Profit = 250 - 214 = Rs. 36

**∴ Required profit will be Rs. 36**
